load_image_lists: load image paths from AVA frame list files for training or evaluation dataset
load_boxes_and_labels: load bounding boxes and action labels from AVA annotation CSV files for a given mode
parse_bboxes_file: parse AVA bounding box annotation files filtering by detection score threshold and sample rate
get_keyframe_data: extract keyframe indices and corresponding box-label data from boxes_and_labels structure
get_num_boxes_used: count total number of bounding boxes used across all keyframes in the dataset
